source_caption_text:
Never forget when Eminem’s daughter Hailie Jade had the receipts when fans wondered whether she actually listened to her dad’s music 😂❤️

In December 2021, Hailie shared her Spotify Wrapped on TikTok, revealing that Eminem was her most-listened-to artist of the year. She also landed in the top 3% of his listeners, showing that his music was a regular part of her rotation. The reveal gave fans a sweet glimpse of her support for the artist they know as Slim Shady and the man she knows as Dad. 

Their connection has been part of his music for decades. Hailie inspired tracks such as “Hailie’s Song” and “Mockingbird,” where Eminem opened up about fatherhood, family struggles and wanting to give his daughter a better life. Her own voice also appears on “My Dad’s Gone Crazy,” making her part of the catalog she grew up listening to.
